rationale: All four blocking findings are resolved by fix-up commit 1235986d, each with a test that failed before the fix (6 red) and passes now; 41 files / 1050 tests pass, lint and tsc are clean. CR-001: activity now needs a real assistant answer or a genuine user prompt (isGenuineUserTurn), and a new test appends attachment / permission-mode / last-prompt records to a reopened session and keeps it suppressed. CR-002: PreCompact and StopFailure return an empty payload while suppressed. CR-003: an incomplete parent scan (more than 200 siblings, unreadable sibling) returns null instead of []. CR-004: an empty transcript path returns null and inheritedUuids is checked with Array.isArray. No new high-risk issue was found in the fix-up diff, so the blind/edge-case confirmation pass was not needed. Confidence is medium, not high: the original round had no spec to audit against (no-spec), and the check does not re-derive that.
